stories.title: Cronenworth's HR, King's relief help Padres stay alive in NLDS
stories.summary: Jake Cronenworth hit a tiebreaking homer, Game 1 starter Michael King pitched the final two innings and the Padres avoided playoff elimination with a 4-3 victory over the Brewers in Game 3 of their NL Division Series on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Yamamoto outduels Sale as Dodgers take 2-1 NLDS lead over Braves
stories.summary: Yoshinobu Yamamoto dominated the much-anticipated matchup with Atlanta ace Chris Sale, and Kiké Hernández hit a two-run homer as the Dodgers beat the Braves 3-1 to take a 2-1 lead in the NLDS.

stories.title: Eagles All-Pro RT Johnson retires to 'focus on my mental health'
stories.summary: Eagles two-time All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his retirement Tuesday, ending a 14-year career spent entirely in Philadelphia.

stories.title: Messi marks tearful Argentina farewell with goal: Wish I could play forever
stories.summary: Lionel Messi marked his 208th and final game for Argentina with his 126th goal as his country bid an emotional farewell to the global icon.

stories.title: Sources: EuroLeague members reject NBA offer to merge into NBA Europe
stories.summary: Members of the EuroLeague rejected a formal offer from the NBA this week to merge and create a single NBA Europe operation, sources told ESPN.
